Finish as soon as the outcome is verified. The required change is replacing `app-gateway-missing` with `app-gateway` in the `parentRefs` section of `httproute/app-route`.

I will use `kubectl patch` or `edit` for a minimal change. I will use `edit` to ensure I replace the exact incorrect string.
